title: Directional predictability and time-frequency spillovers among clean energy sectors and oil price uncertainty
publisher: Quarterly Review of Economics and Finance 85, 326–341
summary: The paper analyses the dependence between clean energy sectors and oil price uncertainty. Sector responses differ in direction and size depending on the sector, market conditions and investment horizon.
keyFindings: Dependence and predictability from oil market uncertainty to clean energy sectors vary across market conditions and horizons.
Shock spillovers are weak in the short term and grow over intermediate and long horizons.
methods: Wavelet, cross-quantilogram and TVP-VAR models with stochastic volatility on six NASDAQ OMX Green Economy sector indices.
